completion_data.completion_summary: Landed FormalSystem.Semantics.saturation_of_orientedForest and its hgen-parameterised variant: every relation whose underlying undirected multigraph is a forest satisfies the literal TaskFrame.Saturation predicate at ofStepRel over the integers, from IsOrientedForest alone and with no finiteness. The whole mathematical layer (C1, UPL, PEN, UIV, MERGE, DISJ), the target-free merge-point uniqueness that is the residual step, the three Saturation reductions and the duration-minimal selection are all sorry-free in a new FormalSystem/Semantics/OrientedForest.lean, with a build-breaking evidence module pinning seven measured axiom profiles at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] and compiling the minimality fixture. This discharges the Saturation half of ROADMAP hypothesis (H5) and unblocks both the AA carrier layer-split route and the MSO cover step at ZTime; the universal-cover construction, (H5)'s other half, remains with the cover task.
